svg.text: U_SW is a FUNCTIONAL symbol for an RTL9313-class SoC (8x 2.5G SerDes + 4x 10G + DDR3 + SPI).
It is not the Realtek ball map. Bind the vendor BGA and move these net names onto the real pins before layout.
HiSGMII: PHY HSOP/HSON are already AC-coupled. Caps on HSIP/HSIN are here, next to the SoC TX pins.
Bootstrap resistors on the RTL9313 GPIO strap pins are not drawn. Copy them from the Realtek hardware design guide.
V095_SOC is the buck on sheet 03. It is a different rail from the eight PHY 0.95 V supplies.
